meta.plant_name: Meridian Compass Data Center power station

units.notes: I checked the Mississippi air permit 1460-00133, issued June 24, 2026. Each of the 10 buildings has 40 generators of 2,000 kilowatts plus one of 800 and one of 500 kilowatts. That agrees with GEM's 800 MW for buildings 1 to 10 and 13 MW for Unit 11.
